uri.title: Connection URI
uri.description: redis:// or rediss:// for direct Redis; grpc:// or grpc+tls:// for Flight SQL. URL-encode credentials. Use URI read_timeout to bound Redis reads.

connection_type.description: Flight SQL requires a separately operated compatible SQL gateway.

schemas.description: Exact database schema names to discover. Use an empty string for a gateway without schemas. Only tables and views exposed through ADBC metadata are read.

catalog.description: Optional exact catalog name; required when stream names would otherwise be ambiguous across catalogs.

batch_size.description: Redis Arrow batch row limit. Gateway batch sizes are controlled by its server.

read_consistency.title: Read consistency requirement
read_consistency.description: best_effort uses separate statement read views. shared_snapshot binds metadata and all selected managed table/view reads in one full-refresh attempt to the same catalog generation. Requires direct Redis ADBC v0.0.24 or compatible newer library and protocol-17 storage. Flight SQL shared snapshots are unsupported.

snapshot_retention_ms.title: Shared snapshot lifetime (milliseconds)
snapshot_retention_ms.description: Fixed lifetime for shared_snapshot mode, including metadata planning and complete consumption of every selected table. Default 15 minutes; maximum one hour. Expiry fails the attempt without switching to live data. Each check, discover and read request acquires its own view.

database_options.description: Additional trusted ADBC driver database options. URI, driver and transaction settings cannot be overridden.

tls_ca_certificate.title: Redis TLS CA certificate
tls_ca_certificate.description: PEM trust bundle for direct rediss:// connections. Use this instead of a CA file when Airbyte runs the connector on another machine.
